label: lem:cyclotomic-embed
title: Existence of the cyclotomic embedding
statement:
For every $n : \mathbb{N}$ there exists a $\mathbb{Q}$-algebra homomorphism
  \[
    \varphi : \mathrm{CyclotomicField}\,n\,\mathbb{Q} \longrightarrow \mathbb{C}.
  \]
  In particular, there is a ring homomorphism \verb|CyclotomicField n ℚ →+* ℂ|.
proof:
We split on $n$.

  If $n = 0$, the source $\mathrm{CyclotomicField}\,0\,\mathbb{Q}$ is canonically $\mathbb{Q}$-isomorphic to $\mathbb{Q}$ itself (cf.~the $n = 0$ branch of Lemma~\ref{lem:cyclotomic-algebraic}, which rests on \verb|Polynomial.cyclotomic_zero|).  The required ring/algebra homomorphism is therefore just the algebra map $\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{C}$, i.e.\ \verb|algebraMap ℚ ℂ| precomposed with the canonical isomorphism.

  If $n \geq 1$, we introduce the typeclass instance \verb|haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩| (which is needed for the cyclotomic-extension typeclasses to fire).  Lemma~\ref{lem:cyclotomic-algebraic} then provides \verb|Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ (CyclotomicField n ℚ)|, which is the hypothesis required by \verb|IsAlgClosed.lift|.  We apply \verb|IsAlgClosed.lift| with source $S = \mathrm{CyclotomicField}\,n\,\mathbb{Q}$, base ring $R = \mathbb{Q}$, and target $M = \mathbb{C}$, using \verb|Complex.isAlgClosed| to discharge the algebraic-closure instance on $\mathbb{C}$.  Coerce the resulting $\mathbb{Q}$-algebra homomorphism to a ring homomorphism via \verb|AlgHom.toRingHom|.
